def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Improved version of the equation, incorporating transconductance and threshold voltage."""
    
    transconductance, threshold_voltage = parameters[:2]
    coupling_parameter = parameters[2]
    
    prefactor = transconductance * (gate_voltage_abs - threshold_voltage)
    
    return prefactor + coupling_parameter * gate_voltage_abs * drain_voltage_abs
